hover.desc: Also opens the popup when the pointer hovers its target and closes it when the pointer leaves both the target and the popup; Click/tap and keyboard interactions keep toggling as usual (touch devices fall back to them)

hover-delay.desc: Delay (in milliseconds) between the pointer entering the target and the popup showing up; Requires the 'hover' prop

hover-hide-delay.desc: Grace period (in milliseconds) in which the pointer can re-enter the target or the popup before it gets closed; Requires the 'hover' prop
